header.running_head: The Janaazah salaah for Rasulullaah ﷺ

blocks.text:
door. Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) and the members of the Banu Abdul Muttalib family came and stood (guard) at the door.
(Addressing Rasulullaah ﷺ) Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "May my parents be sacrificed for you! You were so pure in life and now so pure in death." There wafted from the body of Rasulullaah ﷺ an extremely wonderful fragrance that people had never smelt before. Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) then said to Hadhrat Ali (RA), "What is happening here? Leave all that weeping like women do. Pay attention to your leader (Rasulullaah ﷺ)." Hadhrat Ali (RA) then asked for Hadhrat Fadhl bin Abbaas (RA) to be brought to him (to assist him). At this stage the Ansaar requested, "We plead to you in the name of Allaah and by the affinity we have with Rasulullaah ﷺ (that you allow one of us to be part of the burial preparations)." Hadhrat Ali (RA) and those with him allowed in an Ansaari called Hadhrat Aws bin Khowlay who carried a bucket of water in one hand.
(Before starting the bathing) They heard a voice in the house saying, "Do not remove Rasulullaah ﷺ's clothing. Bathe him as he is in his clothing."
Hadhrat Ali (RA) then washed Rasulullaah ﷺ by placing his hand beneath the clothing as Hadhrat Fadhl (RA) held the clothing up and the Ansaari brought the water. Hadhrat Ali (RA) wore a cloth over his hand (as a glove) as he placed his hand beneath the clothing.[^1]
The Janaazah salaah for Rasulullaah ﷺ
The Narration of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA)

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) narrates that when Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away, groups of men were let into the room and they performed the Janaazah salaah individually without anyone being the Imaam. When all the men were finished, the women were let in to perform the Janaazah salaah, followed by the children and then the slaves. None of the groups were led by an Imaam.[^2]
The Narration of Hadhrat Sahl bin Sa'd (RA)

Hadhrat Sahl in Sa'd (RA) says that after Rasulullaah ﷺ was shrouded in the burial shroud, he was placed on a bed, which was then placed in the corner of the room. The people then entered the room in groups (to perform the Janaazah salaah) without anyone leading them in the salaah.[^3]

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Moosa bin Muhammad bin Ibraheem
blocks.text: Hadhrat Moosa bin Muhammad bin Ibraheem says that he found a book in which his father had written that after Rasulullaah ﷺ was shrouded in the burial shroud, he was placed on a bed. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and Hadhrat Umar (RA) then entered the room together with as many Muhaajireen and Ansaar as could fit in the room. The two men said:
blocks.arabic_text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ اَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ

blocks.text: Tabraani. Haythami (Vol.9 Pg.36) has commented on the chain of narrators. Ibn Maajah has reported a part of the narration while Ibn Sa'd (Vol.2 Pg.63) has also reported a similar narration.
